answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46258 Country: India Title: Zakat Question: My question is that can we do sadaqah of goat with a broken horn and can we also do sadqah for she-goat (bakri). Answer ID: 46258 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1192/915/B=1434) Yes, it is correct to do sadaqah of such goat. You also may do the sadaqah of she-goat as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
